basic_info.description:
Bright & Modern 2BR/1.5BA Apartment with Huge Private Deck Available Sept 1
625 Larkin St APT 301, San Francisco, CA 94109
Rent: $3,150/month (plus fixed monthly utility fee)
Total Monthly Cost: $3,400 $3,600 depending on parking
Bedrooms: 2
Bathrooms: 1.5
Unit Size: 734 sqft (interior) + ~700-800 sqft private deck

 

 Property Highlights:
	 	Expansive Private Rooftop Deck: Enjoy ~700 800 sqft of exclusive outdoor space perfect for outdoor dining, working from home, or relaxing under the sun.
	 	Fully Renovated Interior: Modernized throughout with a brand-new kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, and appliances.
	 	Unbeatable Downtown Location: Walk Score 99! Steps from major tech offices (Airbnb, Uber, Pinterest, LinkedIn, OpenAI), 20+ restaurants within 1 block, and close to groceries like Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, and Target.
	 	In-Unit Laundry: Full-sized washer and dryer included.
	 	Fully Furnished: Move in with everything you need bed, sofa, dining table, chairs, and outdoor patio furniture all provided.
	 	Abundant Natural Light: Bright, airy, and thoughtfully laid out.
	 	Quiet, Well-Maintained Building: Built in 1990, with friendly neighbors and a calm atmosphere.
	 	Pet Friendly: Small dogs and cats welcome (verify with property manager).
	 	Optional Parking: Dedicated garage space available for an additional $200/month.

 

 Transparent Pricing Breakdown:
	 	Base Rent: $3,150/month
	 	Fixed Monthly Utility Fee: $150 (includes building water & hot water)
	 	High-Speed Internet: $100/month (building-provided, non-optional)
	 	Optional Parking: $200/month

 The only variable utility is PG&E (electricity & gas), which is separately metered and paid by tenant.
Everything else water, hot water, and internet is a fixed monthly cost.

Total Estimated Monthly Cost: $3,400 $3,600, depending on whether parking is needed.

 

 The Apartment:

Step into this tastefully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom apartment with 734 sqft of indoor space and an extraordinary amount of private outdoor living area. The unit features modern appliances including a full-size fridge, oven, microwave, and dishwasher. Both bedrooms are spacious and well-proportioned ideal for roommates or a small family. Hardwood and tile floors add a contemporary feel, and the in-unit laundry brings everyday convenience.

 

 The Neighborhood Civic Center / Tenderloin:

Centrally located in San Francisco's cultural and transit hub:
	 	Transit Score: 100 ("Rider's Paradise")
	 	Bike Score: 94 ("Biker's Paradise")
	 	Walking distance to the SF Ballet, Opera House, Asian Art Museum, Civic Auditorium, and the vibrant "Little Saigon" stretch of Larkin Street. Surrounded by parks, shops, and some of the city's best food.

 

 Lease Terms & Screening Requirements:
	 	Available: Starting September 1
	 	Lease Term: 1 year minimum
	 	Utilities: Gas & electricity paid by tenant. Water/hot water/internet handled via fixed fees.
	 	No Smoking
	 	Move-in Funds: Last month's rent due at signing

 Screening Criteria (required before scheduling a tour):
	 	Income: $9,000/month pre-tax minimum
	 	Credit Score: 700+

Note: Inquiries without completing the screening process will not receive tour scheduling.

 

 Contact Us Today!

Click "Request a Tour" or "Contact Property Manager" via Zillow to get started.

Owner pays for water. Renter responsible for gas and electric. Last month's rent due at signing. No smoking allowed. Up to small pets permitted.

Garage parking available for an additional $200/month (optional).

All appliances and furniture are brand new and fully functional. The first month is considered a testing period landlord will cover any repair costs due to defects or setup issues during this period. After the first month, tenant is responsible for repair costs due to damage or malfunction.
